description: This Java source file defines an abstract class ModelFormAction with nested classes for specific actions such as Service invocation and CallParentActions, used within the OFBiz widget modeling framework to handle dynamic form actions. It includes methods for reading sub-actions from XML elements, executing services, and invoking parent form actions, emphasizing the processing and execution of form-related behaviors in a web application.

classes.name: ModelFormAction
classes.description: Abstract class representing a form action within the OFBiz widget framework, providing mechanisms to read and execute sub-actions and define specific action implementations via nested classes.

classes.name: ModelFormAction.CallParentActions
classes.description: Nested class modeling the '<call-parent-actions>' XML element, responsible for invoking actions on parent forms depending on the context, including specifying whether to run form actions or row actions.

classes.name: ModelFormAction.Service
classes.description: Nested class modeling the '<service>' XML element, handling the configuration and execution of service calls, including dynamic service name expansion, service invocation with context, and result handling.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads sub-action definitions from an XML parent element and creates a list of ModelAction instances representing each action, handling different node types such as service, entity conditions, and call for parent actions.
